authority.mode_selection: launcher before native session and Unity scene assembly

launcher.missing_owner_input: clear error for Classic HD and Unity Enhanced; explicit debug fallback only for Exact

exact.owner_inputs: qualified package, closure, and owner cache
exact.window_policy: corrected 4:3 rectangle; pillarbox widescreen window only
exact.fallback: -mc-debug is an explicit diagnostic mode, never an implicit HD/Enhanced fallback

classic-hd.owner_inputs: same external package, closure, and owner cache; never embedded
classic-hd.window_policy: 4:3 game viewport pillarboxed in widescreen window
classic-hd.hud_policy: integer-scaled 640x480 source-style HUD; no widescreen reflow in v1
classic-hd.rerender_rule: recompute indexed world at the selected internal resolution; never upscale Exact FINAL MAIN

unity-enhanced.owner_inputs: same external package, closure, and owner cache; never embedded
unity-enhanced.fallback: diagnostic no-owner-input scene with a non-qualified badge

invariants.command_stream: identical bytes and order for the same input recording
invariants.gameplay_event_stream: identical Rust-authoritative events after presentation-only fields are removed
invariants.reset_and_restart: fresh session reset returns the same package-bound reset hashes
invariants.checkpoint_hashes: compare when a checkpoint exists; do not invent persistent-save equivalence

future_profile_rule: Later Day/cave profiles add a new profile record and corpus root; they do not clone Level 1 session or mode logic.
